# EAH Housing

> > EAH Housing develops and operates affordable housing and supportive services for low-income families, seniors, and vulnerable populations across California and Hawai'i.

EAH Housing is a nonprofit organization dedicated to creating affordable housing solutions and providing comprehensive support services including health and wellness programs. The organization operates across multiple states with a focus on community development and low-income assistance.

## Key Topics

- Affordable Housing
- Nonprofit Housing
- Senior Housing
- Low-Income Assistance
- Community Development
- Health & Wellness Services
